name: velox-trifit
description: Official Velox virtual try-on API guidance and consented TriFit account or limited guest DressMe tools.

interface.shortDescription: Try on outfits and build apps
interface.longDescription: Explore official Velox DressMe API documentation, JavaScript examples and TypeScript declarations without signing in. To try clothing on a selected photo, explicitly connect either your TriFit account or limited guest access. Account mode uses the same TriFit library, history and daily, weekly and monthly allowance as the TriFit website. Guests share the hosted demo queue and its limits; check current allowance and dispatch spacing. Connecting and reading documentation do not generate images. Uploads and new try-ons require permission; no automatic retries or guest-history transfer. AI previews do not guarantee garment fit. Commercial Partner API access requires separate Velox approval.
capabilities: Guided partner application via connected email
defaultPrompt: Show me the Velox API, GitHub examples, TriFit app with free account allowances, and the account-free hosted demo. Explain their limits. Do not generate anything.
Explain guest and TriFit account options, then check my connected allowance without uploading or generating.
Show my selected existing TriFit result without generating another image.
Help me apply for a Partner API key using my connected mailbox. Confirm my sender email, ask for optional project details and show the message before sending.
